definitions.gloss: edema; swelling caused by excess fluid in body tissues
definitions.explanation: A medical term for abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin or in body cavities, causing swelling. Common in the legs, ankles, and feet.

examples.english: There is swelling in the legs.

examples.japanese: {浮腫|ふしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I underwent tests to determine the cause of the edema.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浮腫|ふしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じ→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Standing for long hours at work tends to cause swelling in the legs by evening.

notes:
The medical/formal term for edema or swelling. Composed of {浮|ふ} (float, swell) + {腫|しゅ} (swelling, tumor). In everyday speech, people more commonly say ⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧. The word {浮腫|ふしゅ} is primarily used in medical settings and health-related writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浮腫|ふしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to develop edema
- {浮腫|ふしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: for swelling to go down
- {下肢|かし}{浮腫|ふしゅ}: lower limb edema
- ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧{浮腫|ふしゅ}: pulmonary edema

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧: swelling — the everyday word for puffiness or swelling
- {腫|は}れ: swelling — general swelling from injury, inflammation, or insect bites
- {水腫|すいしゅ}: hydropsy — a more technical term for fluid accumulation
